about: Every screen, panel and card of ST-Copilot, with how to reach it, what it does, its controls, the source that builds it, its screenshot (docs/screens/<screen>.jpg, made by tools/ui-screens.mjs) and open findings. Built for the UI review; keep it in step with the code: a new screen or setting gets a node here.

findingTypes.drift: Two places that should match do not
findingTypes.i18n: Visible text that is not translatable
findingTypes.missing: Something expected that is not there

areas.blurb: Where Copilot plugs into SillyTavern's own UI.

areas.title: Proposal cards

nodes.title: Wand menu entry
nodes.opens: SillyTavern's wand (Extensions) menu, bottom left of the chat bar
nodes.purpose: Opens or hides the Copilot window.

controls.label: ST-Copilot (also the name in Manage Extensions)

findings.text: The extension is named "Copilot (ST)" in manifest.json (what SillyTavern's Manage Extensions list shows) but "ST-Copilot" here, in the window title and in the drawer.

nodes.title: Extensions panel launcher
nodes.purpose: A short launcher in SillyTavern's Extensions panel: turn Copilot on or off, keep the floating icon, open the window or Copilot's Settings. Every other setting lives only in the Settings overlay (3.1.0; it used to be a second, drifting copy of most of them).

findings.text: The "Apply Regex Scripts to context" label closes before its checkbox, so the checkbox sits outside the label and clicking the text does nothing.

Two settings surfaces for the same settings. The drawer is missing: model override, Prompt Manager AI edits, show changelog on update / What's New, memory toast + memory prompt + memory list, max tool rounds, tools prompt and the tool list.
Only the drawer has "Inject memory into AI context" (memoryInject); the overlay's Memory tab has no such switch.

Wording differs from the overlay: "Use Currently Selected API" vs "Use Current API"; "Response String Trimming" vs "Reasoning Trim Strings"; "Session History Depth Limit" vs "Session History Limit"; "Apply Regex Scripts to context" vs "Apply Regex to context"; "Clear Sessions / Clean Up Files / Debug Log" vs "Clear All Sessions / Clean Up Orphan Files / Download Debug Log"; shortcut "Toggle Ghost Mode" vs "Ghost Mode".
Max Response Tokens shows placeholder 2048; the real default is 8048 (same in the overlay).
Expanded, the drawer is about 5,500px tall: every prompt is an auto-growing textarea. Decide whether the drawer should keep full prompt editors or point to the overlay.

nodes.title: Floating icon
nodes.opens: Minimize button in the window header, or always shown with "Always show floating icon"
nodes.purpose: Restores the minimized window. Draggable; remembers its position.

nodes.title: Keyboard shortcuts
nodes.purpose: Toggle the window (Alt+Shift+C, not while typing in another text box), search the Copilot session (Ctrl+F, only while the Copilot window is active), toggle Ghost Mode (Alt+Shift+G). Each can be turned off or rebound in Settings > Interface.

findings.text: Checked while writing the README: Ctrl+F only belongs to Copilot while its window is active (you last clicked in it, or just opened it); elsewhere the browser's own find works. The README documents this, and that Alt+Shift+C is ignored while typing in another text box.

nodes.title: Copilot window
nodes.opens: Wand menu, floating icon or Alt+Shift+C
nodes.purpose: A floating, resizable chat with an assistant that can read the roleplay and propose edits to cards, lorebooks, chat messages and prompts.

controls.label: Drag the header to move; drag any edge or corner to resize

nodes.title: Header
nodes.purpose: Title, the active character badge, and window buttons.

controls.label: Settings (dot when session overrides are active)

nodes.title: Toolbar
nodes.purpose: Session switcher, context depth and the menu to the managers.

controls.label: Depth (Chat Depth): SillyTavern chat messages sent with each request (click the number to type it)
Pick specific chat messages (replaces the Ctx slider)
Menu: Lorebook Manager, Character Manager, Prompt Manager

findings.text: The same setting is "Ctx" here and "Main Chat Depth" in Settings. A tooltip exists, but one name would read better.

nodes.title: Session dropdown
nodes.purpose: Lists this chat's Copilot sessions under "Sessions for this chat" (temporary ones marked tmp), and creates, exports and imports sessions.

findings.text: Sessions belong to the current SillyTavern chat; switching chats shows a different list. The dropdown does not say so (parked idea: global sessions).

nodes.title: Menu
nodes.opens: Menu button at the right of the toolbar
nodes.purpose: Opens the three managers.

controls.label: Lorebook Manager, Character Manager, Prompt Manager

nodes.title: Search bar
nodes.purpose: Finds text in the current Copilot session and steps through matches.

nodes.title: Assistant message
nodes.purpose: Shows the reply with its reasoning (collapsible, with thinking time), tool calls, model and connection, and actions on hover.

controls.label: Copy, Edit, Regen, Delete, Star, Continue response
Swipes: previous, counter, next / new swipe, delete swipe

findings.text: Hover button titles (Copy, Edit, Regen, Delete, Star message, Unstar, Continue response) and the swipe titles (Previous swipe, New swipe) are plain strings, not translated.

nodes.title: Your message
nodes.purpose: Your message with its token count and attachments. Edit offers Save & Resend.

controls.label: Copy, Edit (Save & Resend, Save, Cancel), Regen, Delete, Star

findings.text: The edit buttons Save & Resend / Save / Cancel are not translated.

nodes.title: Tool call card
nodes.opens: Inside a reply that used a tool
nodes.purpose: Shows which tool ran, its status, and (expanded) its input and result. ask_user shows a question with an answer field.

nodes.title: Status bar
nodes.opens: Above the actions bar while Copilot is writing
nodes.purpose: Shows Thinking…, the tool round (Tool round N (max M)…) and, after 10 s of silence, "Model still working · no output for Ns". Stop aborts.

findings.text: "Thinking…" in window.html and "Round N/6…" in api.js are not translated (the idle notice is).
"Round 2/6" reads like a fixed plan; it is "tool round 2, at most 6". Consider "Tool round 2 (max 6)".

nodes.title: Actions bar
nodes.purpose: Context inspector, regenerate, quick prompts, starred messages, and the estimated token and message counts.

nodes.title: Quick prompts bar
nodes.opens: Lightning button in the actions bar
nodes.purpose: One-click prompts (Analyze, Ideas, Summary, Feelings, Next? by default). Edited in Settings > Quick Prompts.

nodes.title: Starred messages
nodes.opens: Star button in the actions bar
nodes.purpose: Lists starred messages of the session; click one to jump to it.

nodes.title: Input and attachments
nodes.purpose: Type a message (Enter sends, Shift+Enter new line), attach files or images. Images go to the API directly or through Image Captioning (Settings > Interface > File Attachments).

nodes.title: Ghost Mode
nodes.opens: Ghost button in the header or Alt+Shift+G
nodes.purpose: Makes the window transparent and click-through so you can read the chat underneath.

nodes.title: Lorebook changes card
nodes.opens: A reply with a lorebook-changes block
nodes.purpose: Adds, edits, patches, appends to or deletes lorebook entries; each change has diff, edit, apply and reject.

controls.label: Per change: View diff, Edit before applying, Apply, Reject
Edit form: name, keys, content, Constant, Outlet Entry + Outlet Name

nodes.title: Character edits card
nodes.opens: A reply with a character-changes block
nodes.purpose: Overwrite, replace (anchor patches), prepend or append text to a card field, or add / rewrite alternate greetings. Accepted edits go to SillyTavern's live copy of the character (3.0.7).

controls.label: Per change: View diff, Edit before applying (Add Patch, Remove), Apply, Reject
Change all N (when an anchor repeats)

findings.text: Two different actions both read APPEND: "+ Append" adds a new alternate greeting, "⬇ Append" adds text to the end of a field. Suggest "+ New greeting" for the first.

nodes.title: New character card
nodes.opens: A reply with a character-create block
nodes.purpose: Review and edit a proposed new character, then create it in SillyTavern.

controls.label: Name, Tags, Description, Personality, Scenario, First Message, Example Dialogue

nodes.title: Chat edits card
nodes.opens: A reply with a chat-changes block
nodes.purpose: Edits SillyTavern chat messages: prepend, append, add, delete, hide/unhide, overwrite, patch, regex, bulk replace, rename the chat.

controls.label: Per change: View diff, Edit before applying, Apply, Reject
Apply All, Reject All, Dismiss all

nodes.title: Prompt edits card
nodes.opens: A reply with a prompt-changes block (needs Prompt Manager AI edits on)
nodes.purpose: Edits or toggles prompts in SillyTavern's Prompt Manager; saved to settings, and to the preset file only via Update preset file.

controls.label: Per change: text preview (click to expand), View diff, Edit before applying, Apply, Reject
Change all N (when an anchor repeats)

findings.text: Unlike the other cards: no Apply All / Reject All buttons, no Edit before applying, and no text preview under the change (only the diff button).

nodes.title: Diff view
nodes.purpose: Before and after of one change, split or unified.

findings.text: The title "Diff View" is not translated.
The diff modal's markup lives in lorebook_manager.html though every card uses it.

nodes.title: AI tab
nodes.purpose: Everything that shapes requests: configuration profile, connection, what context is sent, and the prompts for each kind of edit. All of it belongs to the selected configuration profile.

controls.label: Configuration Profiles: select, save, new, duplicate, rename, delete; auto-load for character / chat
Connection: Use Current API / Use Specific Profile / Custom Endpoint
Connection Profile + Model (blank = profile's model) + load model list
Endpoint URL, API Key, Model Name
Streaming: Auto / Force On / Force Off
Include my ST roleplay prompt, User Persona, auto-expand macros, hidden messages, alternate swipes
Character fields sent (10) + which greetings to include
Chat Depth, Session History Limit, Remove From Replies
Third-party: Apply Regex, Summaryception, Aspect: Evolutia
System Prompt with presets + Reset to Default
Character Card AI Edits: enable + prompt (with presets)
Lorebook AI Edits: enable, Auto-Keywords, Copilot messages scanned for lorebook keys, prompt (with presets)
Chat Message AI Edits: enable + prompt (with presets)
Prompt Manager AI Edits: enable (with presets)

findings.text: "Copilot keytriggers scan depth" is jargon; it is how many of your own Copilot messages are scanned for lorebook keys. The drawer's note that main chat entries follow SillyTavern's World Info is missing here.
"Reasoning Trim Strings" removes strings from replies (empty <think></think> blocks); the name suggests it only touches reasoning.
System prompt presets exist only in the Session tab; the AI tab has just Reset.
Found by the inventory drift test: includeAuthorsNote and includeCharacterCard were saved in every configuration profile but nothing read them. Removed, also from saved profiles.

nodes.title: Interface tab
nodes.purpose: Look and behaviour of the window: general switches, shortcuts, completion sound, Ghost Mode, background, message picker previews, attachments and theme.

controls.label: Enable, floating icon, wobbly drag, Low Performance Mode, show changelog on update, What's New, Window Opacity
controls.setting: enabled, floatingIconPersistent, wobbleWindow, performanceMode, changelogAutoShow, opacity

controls.label: Shortcuts (3)
controls.setting: hotkeyEnabled, hotkey, searchHotkeyEnabled, searchHotkey, ghostModeHotkeyEnabled, ghostModeHotkey

controls.label: Completion Sound: presets, custom upload, test, delete, volume, only when unfocused
Window Background: none / custom, upload or URL, rename, delete, dim
Context Message Picker: first N lines, last N lines
Interface Theme: 12 presets, custom themes (save, new, duplicate, rename, delete, export, import), 20 color and style fields

findings.text: The Danger Zone (sessions, files, debug log) is not about the interface. A Data or Maintenance group, or its own place, would be easier to find.
"Clear All Sessions" deletes the sessions of the current chat only (the confirm says so; the button does not).
Theme field labels (Background, Accent, Header BG, …) and the theme preset names are not translated.

nodes.title: Quick Prompts tab
nodes.purpose: Edit the quick prompts bar and save or load whole sets of them.

controls.label: Prompt Sets: load, save, new, rename, delete
Each prompt: icon, label, move up/down, delete, text (macros allowed)

nodes.title: Session tab
nodes.purpose: Overrides for the current Copilot session only; each has a reset (↺). Includes prompt presets, and at the bottom the session and file maintenance buttons.

controls.label: Connection source / profile / custom endpoint, Max Tokens, Streaming
Include roleplay prompt, User Persona, alternate swipes, auto-expand macros, hidden messages
Character fields (10) + greetings picker, with a "set by <character>" tag where a character override wins
Chat Depth, History Limit, Remove From Replies
Character / Lorebook / Chat edit switches and prompts, each with presets
Prompt Manager AI Edits, Persistent memory, Tool calls
Sessions and files: Clear All Sessions (this chat), Clean Up Orphan Files, Download Debug Log

findings.text: No session override for: auto-expand macros, include hidden messages, Summaryception, Aspect: Evolutia, Prompt Manager AI edits, memory, tools.
Three layers decide which character fields are sent: global (AI tab), this session (here) and per character (Character Manager > Overrides). Nothing shows which layer wins.

nodes.title: Memory tab
nodes.opens: Gear button > Memory (dot when memory is active)
nodes.purpose: Persistent memory about you as a user of Copilot (preferences, standing instructions). Copilot adds memories itself; you can add, edit, disable or delete them.

controls.label: Enable persistent memory, inject memory into AI context, toast when memory is saved
Stored Memories: enable/disable, edit, delete, expand; Add (category, value, scope)

findings.text: No "Inject memory into AI context" switch here (memoryInject); it is only in the drawer.
memoryScope and memoryTag defaults are never read.

nodes.title: Tools tab
nodes.purpose: Lets Copilot look things up before answering, with one switch per tool.

controls.label: 13 tools: Search Chat History, Search Lorebook Entries, Get Lorebooks, Ask User, Get Character Info, Read Messages, Get Generation Settings, Get Regex Scripts, Get Quick Replies, Get Lorebook Entry, Get Roleplay Prompts, Get Chat Statistics, Get Recent Messages

findings.text: toolsThinking default is never read.
toolsEnabled_get_prompts has no default (works because unset counts as on); every other tool has one.
Tool names and descriptions, and the "requires streaming" warning for Ask User, are not translated.
Found while checking the Korean UI: a tool's name and description sat side by side, so a long description squeezed the name to one character per line. The description now gets its own line.

nodes.title: Stats tab
nodes.purpose: Usage counts (messages, regens, sessions, tokens in/out, quick prompts, lorebook changes, edits) as cards and a chart over time.

controls.label: Scope: Global / Character / Chat; Period: 30 Days / 12 Weeks / 12 Mo / All Years

findings.text: Abbreviated metric names (QPrompts, LB Changes) and the "12 Mo" period; the metric names and the Scope / Period row labels are not translated.

nodes.title: Lorebook Manager
nodes.purpose: Browse the active lorebooks (global, character, chat, persona), choose which are sent to Copilot, and see which entries are in context.

controls.label: Lorebooks list with source badge (G/C/Ch/P) and include checkbox; Refresh
Force All On, Force All Off, Reset All, New Entry
Entry rows: in-context marker (active in ST / in context), force toggle

findings.text: "New Entry", "Select a lorebook" and the entry count line are not translated.
lorebookEnabled default is never read.

nodes.title: Lorebook entry
nodes.opens: Click an entry in the Lorebook Manager
nodes.purpose: Edit an entry's name, keys and content, toggle it in the lorebook, and choose whether Copilot always, never or normally sees it.

controls.label: Copilot Context Injection: Default / Force On / Force Off

findings.text: The initial "Entry" title and "Enabled" status are not translated in the template.

nodes.title: Character Manager
nodes.purpose: View and edit the card fields of the chat's characters and your persona, with token counts, and choose per character which fields Copilot sees.

controls.label: Participants: persona (locked) and characters, each with an include-in-context checkbox
Banner: avatar, name, total tokens, Save, Revert

Current Info: Identity (Name, Tags), Description, Personality, Scene (Scenario, First Message, Example Dialogue), Advanced (Main Prompt Override, Post-History Instructions), Alternate Greetings (edit, delete, add)
Unsaved changes dialog: Cancel, Discard, Save & Exit

findings.text: Tab names "Current Info" / "Overrides" and the field group labels are not translated.
The persona shows only its description, with a lock icon and no hint why; "Adding Persona to context is managed in global settings" appears only as a tooltip.

nodes.title: Character overrides
nodes.purpose: Per character: which card fields are sent to Copilot. Each field says which layer decides it: "set here", "from this session" or "from global settings".

findings.text: Found while adding the layer tags: without an override here, a field showed the global setting even when a session override decided it, and the hint said "falls back to global settings".

nodes.title: Prompt Manager
nodes.purpose: SillyTavern's roleplay prompts in send order: turn each on or off, edit its text, and write the result into the preset file.

controls.label: Prompts (send order), slots marked; Send this prompt toggle
Prompt text with token count, Save, Revert

nodes.title: Context inspector
nodes.opens: Context button in the actions bar
nodes.purpose: Shows exactly what Copilot sends: the assembled messages (Formatted), the raw JSON, and the last request bodies SillyTavern actually sent (Last sent).

findings.text: The title "Raw Context Payload" is not translated.

nodes.title: What's New
nodes.opens: Settings > Interface > What's New, or automatically after an update
nodes.purpose: Release notes for this fork (3.0.0 on) and upstream's earlier versions.

nodes.title: Pick context messages
nodes.purpose: Choose exactly which SillyTavern chat messages Copilot sees, instead of the last N.

controls.label: Message rows (Shift+Click range, Ctrl same sender, Alt opposite sender)

findings.text: "Apply" and the initial "0 selected" are not translated.

nodes.title: New session
nodes.purpose: Name a new session, optionally temporary (deleted when you switch away). On SillyTavern's Popup since 3.1.1, like Copilot's other dialogs.

findings.text: Still a Copilot-styled overlay, while alert/confirm/prompt moved to SillyTavern's Popup in 3.0.6 (known, parked).

nodes.title: Confirm and prompt dialogs
nodes.purpose: SillyTavern's own Popup for alerts, confirmations (destructive ones count down) and name prompts.

nodes.title: Generation error
nodes.purpose: Shows the provider's error with its cause.

nodes.title: Clean up session files
nodes.opens: Settings > Session > Sessions and files > Clean Up Orphan Files
nodes.purpose: Finds Copilot session files no chat points to (deleted chats, old branches) and offers to delete empty ones, then ones that still hold messages.
